lints.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable without signing in. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if it is not meant to be public.

findings.detail: Function `public.can_read_course(p_course_id text)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/can_read_course`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

lints.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.

findings.detail: Function `public.can_read_course(p_course_id text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/can_read_course`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

lints.name: auth_leaked_password_protection
lints.title: Leaked Password Protection Disabled
lints.description: Leaked password protection is currently disabled.

findings.detail: Supabase Auth prevents the use of compromised passwords by checking against HaveIBeenPwned.org. Enable this feature to enhance security.

lints.name: multiple_permissive_policies
lints.title: Multiple Permissive Policies
lints.description: Detects if multiple permissive row level security policies are present on a table for the same \`role\` and \`action\` (e.g. insert). Multiple permissive policies are suboptimal for performance as each policy must be executed for every relevant query.

findings.detail: Table \`public.course_authoring_drafts\` has multiple permissive policies for role \`authenticated\` for action \`SELECT\`. Policies include \`{course_authoring_drafts_teacher_read,course_authoring_drafts_teacher_write}\`
